name: Little Solsbury Hill
place: Batheaston, Bath and North East Somerset, England
summary: Little Solsbury Hill is a small flat-topped hill and the site of an Iron Age hillfort, above the village of Batheaston in Somerset, England. The hill rises to 191 metres (627 ft) above the River Avon, which is just over 2 kilometres (1 mi) to the south, and gives views of the city of Bath and the surrounding area. It is within the Cotswolds Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty.
aka: Little Solsbury Hill Camp, Solsbury Hill, Batheaston
